Because the oasis commitment is timestamped in the wander ledger, the vertex audit verifies the pair and a late swap fails the hash. The answer is committed as a 152 bit hash at open and revealed at close, and a reveal that does not match the commitment is void. Bonded capital sits idle for 3 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
